claim_class: physical source replay and preregistered sensitivity; not independent reactor validation

comparison_boundaries.coulomb: electron-electron and electron-ion Coulomb collisions absent
comparison_boundaries.relative_cl2: Malyshev Eq. 11 observable 100*nCl2/(nCl2+nCl/2); the distinct particle fraction nCl2/(nCl2+nCl) is also reported but never compared to the measurement. The source's about +/-25% absolute-density accuracy is used as a bounded accuracy band, never relabeled as one sigma
comparison_boundaries.rf_heating: Hagelaar-Pitchford high-frequency two-term operator at 13.56 MHz with modern RMS E/N convention; this is a quasi-stationary local-field sensitivity, not a time-periodic or nonlocal ICP electron-heating solution
comparison_boundaries.temperature: 2/3 mean E is a diagnostic proxy, not the exact Malyshev OES observable
comparison_boundaries.wafer_flux: axial global-model flux is not a validated local wafer flux or IED/IAD
comparison_boundaries.wall: bounded Langmuir-Hill coverage response fitted only to Stafford direct spinning-wall markers; the asymptote is the largest direct marker and transfer beyond ratio 0.78 and from 300 to 333 K remains sensitivity evidence
